todaysEvents.summary: No newer Reuters Hormuz report found
todaysEvents.delta: A targeted Reuters search found no Iran/Hormuz shipping article dated Oct 22-23. The latest reviewed Oct 21 report retains the Guards Navy tanker-fire mine-strike claim and Kpler’s 18-attack tally as attributed claims. The latest comparable transit count remains seven all-commodity vessels on Oct 6.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.description: Mediation produces agreed sequencing and monitored reopening. The Oct 20 tanker incident is a source-attributed claim, not an independently confirmed mine strike; no signed deal or durable shipping normalisation is verified.

scenarios.label: Stress
scenarios.summary: Selective passage continues amid shipping disruptions.
scenarios.description: Selective passage and export rerouting coexist with reported incidents. Reuters cites Kpler’s report of 18 vessel attacks over two weeks; the latest comparable Hormuz count remains seven commodity vessels on Oct 6.

scenarios.label: Tail
scenarios.summary: Talks stall or attacks disrupt more export routes.
scenarios.description: Sequencing disagreements persist or attacks further disrupt Hormuz and alternative export routes. War-risk insurance, route-normalised freight and replacement LNG costs remain unverified.
